name: unity-antigravity-mcp
description: Connects Antigravity IDE to Unity 6 Editor and C# projects: native External Script Editor (.csproj/.sln auto-sync), Scene/Hierarchy/Console/Test inspection, and 7 modular atomic batch tools (Scene/Prefab, uGUI + UI Toolkit, Animation, Particle/VFX, Assets/SO, PackageManager/Tools, Universal SerializedObject) with 2-layer owner approval, Undo rollback, Wi-Fi/quota recovery journal, and a portable Multi-Agent Orchestrator kit.
suggestedPrompts: Check Unity Editor status, missing .csproj files, and recent Console errors
Sync Unity .csproj and .sln files to fix CS0229 red squiggles in Antigravity IDE
Inspect the active Scene hierarchy and propose a modular UI, Animation, or Particle batch
